headline: Section dragging and reordering arrives in BetterBags Next.

entries.title: Drag and drop section management in BetterBags Next
entries.details: In the experimental BetterBags Next mode, category sections can now be dragged by their headers to reorder them, with surrounding sections sliding smoothly out of the way. Dropping a section onto a tab assigns its category to that tab, while dragging it between your inventory and bank transfers all of its items.
